role.en: Associate Professor, UC Berkeley; Co-founder, Physical Intelligence
role.zh: UC Berkeley 副教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人

why.en: The most influential researcher in robot learning, and the person who brought the large-model paradigm into manipulation policies. The π series is the frontier of embodied intelligence.
why.zh: 机器人学习领域最具影响力的研究者，把大模型范式引入操作策略。π 系列模型是具身智能的前沿代表。

title.en: π0: A vision-language-action flow model for general robot control
title.zh: π0：面向通用机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作流模型

note.en: Open-sourced February 2025; generalises across laundry, coffee-making, box assembly and vegetable peeling.
note.zh: 2025 年 2 月开源；可泛化到叠衣服、冲咖啡、组装纸箱与削蔬菜等任务。

title.en: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching
title.zh: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching

note.en: Levine and coauthors (Preston Fu, Kevin Frans, Oleh Rybkin, Aviral Kumar) propose progressive point matching for training language models with RL on long-horizon tasks, moving past sparse outcome rewards.
note.zh: 莱文与合著者（Preston Fu、Kevin Frans、Oleh Rybkin、Aviral Kumar）提出渐进式点匹配方法，用强化学习训练语言模型完成长时程任务，突破了稀疏结果奖励的局限。

title.en: Can One AI Model Control Every Robot? | Sergey Levine
title.zh: Can One AI Model Control Every Robot? | Sergey Levine

note.en: Levine discussed building a single AI model that can control many different robots, drawing on his work at Physical Intelligence.
note.zh: 莱文在访谈中探讨了打造一个能控制多种不同机器人的单一AI模型，内容取材于他在Physical Intelligence的研究工作。

title.en: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
title.zh: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency

note.en: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning that lets large generalist robot policies keep acting despite their own inference latency.
note.zh: 提出在推理延迟下继续行动的强化学习微调方法，使大型通用机器人策略在实机部署中保持流畅。

title.en: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
title.zh: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL

note.en: Co-authored study showing that multi-agent RL trained against a single frozen LLM user simulator collapses and fails to generalize to real users.
note.zh: 他与人合著的研究表明，多智能体强化学习若只针对单一固定的大模型用户模拟器训练，会出现模拟器坍缩，无法泛化到真实用户。

title.en: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
title.zh: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?

note.en: An analysis of why predicting and executing multi-step action chunks improves behavioral cloning for robotic control.
note.zh: 分析为何一次预测并执行多步动作（动作分块）能提升机器人控制中行为克隆的效果。

title.en: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
title.zh: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies

note.en: Levine co-authors PolaRiS, a scalable real-to-sim evaluation framework for generalist robot policies.
note.zh: Levine参与的PolaRiS是一个可扩展的真实到仿真评估框架，用于评测通用机器人策略。

title.en: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models
title.zh: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models

note.en: Levine co-authors a study on the emergence of human-to-robot transfer in vision-language-action models.
note.zh: Levine参与研究了视觉-语言-动作模型中人到机器人迁移能力的出现机制。

title.en: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Method for adapting pretrained generalist robot policies to new tasks using reinforcement learning driven by semantic rewards.
note.zh: 提出用语义奖励驱动的强化学习，将预训练的通用机器人策略适配到新任务。

title.en: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL
title.zh: Learning Process Rewards via Success Visitation Matching for Efficient RL

note.en: Derives dense process rewards from success visitation matching so reinforcement learning stays efficient when the task reward is sparse.
note.zh: 通过成功状态访问匹配学习稠密的过程奖励，使强化学习在奖励稀疏的任务中仍能高效训练。

title.en: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs
title.zh: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs

note.en: VIMPO, a value-implicit policy optimization method for reinforcement learning on LLM reasoning, written with Dawn Song and colleagues.
note.zh: 与 Dawn Song 等人合作提出 VIMPO，一种用于大模型推理强化学习的隐式价值策略优化方法。

title.en: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
title.zh: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation

note.en: Paper introducing SC3-Eval, which evaluates robot foundation models through self-consistent action-conditioned video generation instead of real-world rollouts.
note.zh: 论文提出 SC3-Eval，用自洽的动作条件视频生成来评测机器人基础模型，替代昂贵的真机测试。

title.en: Reversal Q-Learning
title.zh: Reversal Q-Learning

note.en: A new offline reinforcement learning algorithm built on flow matching to model complex behaviors from fixed datasets.
note.zh: 提出一种基于流匹配的新离线强化学习算法，用于从固定数据集中建模复杂行为。

title.en: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
title.zh: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering

note.en: With Chelsea Finn and his students, steers generalist robot policies toward new tasks by reversing their flow-based action generation.
note.zh: 与 Chelsea Finn 等人合作，通过反转基于流的动作生成来引导通用机器人策略完成新任务。

title.en: Sergey Levine on Why Real-World Data Will Define Physical AI
title.zh: Sergey Levine on Why Real-World Data Will Define Physical AI

note.en: Interview on why real-world experience, rather than simulation or demo videos, will decide the pace of physical AI.
note.zh: 访谈：他解释为何真实世界的经验而非仿真或演示视频，将决定具身智能的发展速度。

title.en: Measuring and Mitigating the Distributional Gap Between Real and Simulated User Behaviors
title.zh: Measuring and Mitigating the Distributional Gap Between Real and Simulated User Behaviors

note.en: Measures how far LLM user simulators drift from real user behavior and proposes ways to close that gap.
note.zh: 量化大模型用户模拟器与真实用户行为之间的分布差距，并提出缩小该差距的方法。

title.en: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
title.zh: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies

note.en: OGPO, an off-policy method for sample-efficient full fine-tuning of diffusion- and flow-based robot control policies.
note.zh: 提出 OGPO：一种样本高效的离策略方法，用于对扩散式与流式机器人控制策略做全参数微调。

title.en: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with Vision-Language-Action Models
title.zh: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with Vision-Language-Action Models

note.en: Bootstraps online reinforcement learning from pretrained vision-language-action models so robots reach the precision and speed real tasks demand.
note.zh: 利用预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型引导在线强化学习，使机器人达到真实任务所需的精度与速度。

title.en: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
title.zh: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities

note.en: Physical Intelligence's π0.7 robotic foundation model, the latest generation of the π series he co-leads.
note.zh: Physical Intelligence 发布的 π0.7 机器人基础模型，是他参与主导的 π 系列的最新一代。

title.en: #331 Sergey Levine: The Robot Revolution Nobody Is Talking About
title.zh: #331 Sergey Levine: The Robot Revolution Nobody Is Talking About

note.en: Eye on A.I. interview on the state of robot learning and the robotics shift he thinks is being overlooked.
note.zh: 在 Eye on A.I. 节目中谈机器人学习现状，以及他认为被外界忽视的机器人变革。

title.en: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment
title.zh: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment

note.en: Uses generative models with adversarial distribution alignment to close the gap between physical simulation and real experiment.
note.zh: 用生成模型与对抗式分布对齐来弥合物理仿真与真实实验之间的差距。

title.en: Sergey Levine - Building LLMs for the Physical World
title.zh: Sergey Levine - Building LLMs for the Physical World

posts.source: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Sh…

note.en: Long-form interview on building foundation models for the physical world at Physical Intelligence.
note.zh: 长篇访谈：谈在 Physical Intelligence 为物理世界构建基础模型的工作。

title.en: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer
title.zh: Offline Materials Optimization with CliqueFlowmer

note.en: Applies offline optimization with a flow-based model to computational materials discovery, co-authored with Pieter Abbeel.
note.zh: 与 Pieter Abbeel 等合作，将基于流模型的离线优化方法用于计算材料发现。

title.en: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
title.zh: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models

note.en: Gives vision-language-action models a multi-scale memory so robots can carry context through long multi-stage tasks.
note.zh: 为视觉-语言-动作模型引入多尺度具身记忆，使机器人能在多阶段长任务中保持上下文。

title.en: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge
title.zh: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge

note.en: An asynchronous VLA architecture that cuts inference cost enough to run robot navigation on edge hardware.
note.zh: 提出异步 VLA 架构，大幅降低推理开销，使机器人导航可在边缘设备上运行。

title.en: Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control
title.zh: Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies for Embodied Reasoning and Hierarchical Control

note.en: Grounds vision-language model priors into hierarchical robot control, yielding steerable policies for embodied reasoning.
note.zh: 将视觉-语言模型的先验落地到分层机器人控制中，得到可引导的具身推理策略。

title.en: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios
title.zh: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios

note.en: Paper on steering vision-language-action models to handle long-tail autonomous driving scenarios.
note.zh: 论文研究如何引导视觉-语言-动作模型应对自动驾驶中的长尾场景。

title.en: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching
title.zh: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching

note.en: Q-learning with Adjoint Matching, a temporal-difference method for efficient optimization in continuous-action reinforcement learning.
note.zh: 提出伴随匹配 Q 学习（QAM），一种面向连续动作强化学习的高效时序差分方法。

title.en: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
title.zh: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics

note.en: General-purpose vision-language reward models that remove the need for hand-designed or human-labeled robot rewards.
note.zh: 提出通用的视觉-语言奖励模型，免去为机器人任务人工设计或标注奖励的负担。

title.en: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning
title.zh: Posterior Behavioral Cloning: Pretraining BC Policies for Efficient RL Finetuning

note.en: Paper proposing posterior behavioral cloning, a pretraining scheme that makes later RL finetuning of policies more efficient.
note.zh: 论文提出后验行为克隆预训练方案，使策略后续的强化学习微调更高效。

title.en: Decoupled Q-Chunking
title.zh: Decoupled Q-Chunking

note.en: Decouples action chunking in temporal-difference learning to reduce bootstrapping bias in offline reinforcement learning.
note.zh: 在时序差分学习中解耦动作分块，以降低离线强化学习中的自举偏差。

title.en: Leveraging Discrete Function Decomposability for Scientific Design
title.zh: Leveraging Discrete Function Decomposability for Scientific Design

note.en: With Bowden and Listgarten, Levine explores leveraging discrete function decomposability for scientific design problems.
note.zh: Levine与Bowden、Listgarten合作，探讨如何利用离散函数的可分解性用于科学设计问题。

title.en: A neat and elegant idea from @seohong_park & Deepinder Mann: represent a state by distances to other states (i.e., how easy it is to reach other states). Th
title.zh: A neat and elegant idea from @seohong_park & Deepinder Mann: represent a state by distances to other states (i.e., how easy it is to reach other states). Th

note.en: Highlights work from his group that represents a state by its distances to other states, giving a representation for goal-conditioned RL.
note.zh: 介绍其团队的工作：用一个状态到其他状态的可达距离来表示该状态，为目标条件强化学习提供表征。

title.en: A new VLA for navigation that can take in goal images, positions, and language, and exhibits some pretty neat emergent language following!
title.zh: A new VLA for navigation that can take in goal images, positions, and language, and exhibits some pretty neat emergent language following!

note.en: Shares a navigation VLA that takes goal images, positions and language, and shows emergent language following.
note.zh: 分享一个可接受目标图像、位置与语言输入的导航 VLA，并展现出涌现的语言跟随能力。

title.en: Fully autonomous robots are much closer than you think – Sergey Levine
title.zh: Fully autonomous robots are much closer than you think – Sergey Levine

note.en: Dwarkesh Podcast interview arguing a self-improvement flywheel will bring general-purpose robots sooner than most expect.
note.zh: 在 Dwarkesh 播客中提出，自我改进飞轮将使通用机器人比多数人预期更早到来。

title.en: The pi-05 model is now in openpi: https://t.co/NLfraCc7zf Now with pytorch (πtorch?) support too!
title.zh: The pi-05 model is now in openpi: https://t.co/NLfraCc7zf Now with pytorch (πtorch?) support too!

note.en: Announces that the π0.5 model is available in the open-source openpi repository, now with PyTorch support.
note.zh: 宣布 π0.5 模型已加入开源项目 openpi，并新增 PyTorch 支持。

title.en: Language following is a tough problem for VLAs: while these models can follow complex language, in practice getting datasets that enable language following is h
title.zh: Language following is a tough problem for VLAs: while these models can follow complex language, in practice getting datasets that enable language following is h

note.en: Describes a counterfactual data method that teaches vision-language-action models to actually follow language instructions.
note.zh: 介绍一种反事实数据生成方法，让视觉-语言-动作模型真正学会遵循语言指令。

title.en: I wrote a fun little article about all the ways to dodge the need for real-world robot data. I think it has a cute title. https://t.co/EIZsCARRRo
title.zh: I wrote a fun little article about all the ways to dodge the need for real-world robot data. I think it has a cute title. https://t.co/EIZsCARRRo

note.en: Points to his own essay surveying the many ways researchers try to avoid collecting real-world robot data.
note.zh: 分享他撰写的文章，梳理研究者们试图绕开采集真实机器人数据的各种做法。

title.en: Action chunking is a great idea in robotics: by getting a model to produce a short sequence of actions, it _just works better_ for some mysterious reason. Now i
title.zh: Action chunking is a great idea in robotics: by getting a model to produce a short sequence of actions, it _just works better_ for some mysterious reason. Now i

note.en: Notes that action chunking, long useful in imitation learning, turns out to help reinforcement learning too.
note.zh: 指出在模仿学习中行之有效的动作分块，同样能提升强化学习的效果。

title.en: Warm-start RL (WSRL) can learn to control a real robot in under 20 minutes! Deep RL is getting really fast. Warm-start from offline data + super-efficient onlin
title.zh: Warm-start RL (WSRL) can learn to control a real robot in under 20 minutes! Deep RL is getting really fast. Warm-start from offline data + super-efficient onlin

note.en: Shares Warm-start RL, which learns to control a real robot in under twenty minutes by combining offline data with efficient online learning.
note.zh: 分享 Warm-start RL（WSRL）：结合离线数据与高效在线学习，可在二十分钟内学会控制真实机器人。

title.en: If you have a policy that uses diffusion/flow (e.g. diffusion VLA), you can run RL where the actor chooses the noise, which is then denoised by the policy to pr
title.zh: If you have a policy that uses diffusion/flow (e.g. diffusion VLA), you can run RL where the actor chooses the noise, which is then denoised by the policy to pr

note.en: Explains an RL method in which the actor chooses the noise that a diffusion or flow policy then denoises into an action.
note.zh: 介绍一种强化学习方法：由 actor 选择噪声，再由扩散或流策略将其去噪成动作。

title.en: Self-supervised representation learning looks a bit like RL. What if we literally use RL as a SSL method for visual representations? Turns out that it works qui
title.zh: Self-supervised representation learning looks a bit like RL. What if we literally use RL as a SSL method for visual representations? Turns out that it works qui

note.en: Shares work using reinforcement learning itself as a self-supervised objective for learning visual representations.
note.zh: 分享将强化学习本身用作自监督目标来学习视觉表征的工作。

title.en: Real-time inference is a big challenge for VLAs. We’ve been working on a way to amortize inference delays in π0.5. Our new Real-Time Chunking (RTC) method speed
title.zh: Real-time inference is a big challenge for VLAs. We’ve been working on a way to amortize inference delays in π0.5. Our new Real-Time Chunking (RTC) method speed

note.en: Introduces Real-Time Chunking, which amortizes inference delay so π0.5 can keep acting while it thinks.
note.zh: 介绍实时分块（RTC）方法：摊薄推理延迟，让 π0.5 能边思考边行动。

title.en: I always found it puzzling how language models learn so much from next-token prediction, while video models learn so little from next frame prediction. Maybe it
title.zh: I always found it puzzling how language models learn so much from next-token prediction, while video models learn so little from next frame prediction. Maybe it

note.en: His reflection on why next-token prediction teaches language models so much while next-frame prediction teaches video models so little.
note.zh: 他的思考：为何下一词预测能让语言模型学到很多，而下一帧预测对视频模型收效甚微。

title.en: Classifier-free guidance is an RL policy improvement operator in (very thin) disguise! This makes it easier than ever to implement RL (and RL-like) methods on t
title.zh: Classifier-free guidance is an RL policy improvement operator in (very thin) disguise! This makes it easier than ever to implement RL (and RL-like) methods on t

note.en: Observes that classifier-free guidance is a reinforcement learning policy improvement operator in thin disguise.
note.zh: 指出无分类器引导（CFG）实质上就是强化学习中的策略改进算子。

title.en: Fun project at PI: knowledge insulation for VLAs. We figured out how to train VLAs with cont. actions much more effectively by insulating the VLM and training i
title.zh: Fun project at PI: knowledge insulation for VLAs. We figured out how to train VLAs with cont. actions much more effectively by insulating the VLM and training i

note.en: Describes knowledge insulation at Physical Intelligence: training the VLM with discrete actions so continuous-action VLAs train more effectively.
note.zh: 介绍 Physical Intelligence 的知识隔离方法：用离散动作训练 VLM 部分，使连续动作 VLA 的训练更加有效。

title.en: We trained a robotic foundation model that can drive mobile robots in six different countries, and navigate Sproul Plaza in midday on the UC Berkeley campus! So
title.zh: We trained a robotic foundation model that can drive mobile robots in six different countries, and navigate Sproul Plaza in midday on the UC Berkeley campus! So

note.en: Announces a robotic foundation model that drives mobile robots in six countries, including across UC Berkeley's Sproul Plaza at midday.
note.zh: 宣布一个机器人基础模型可在六个国家驱动移动机器人，包括在正午穿行加州大学伯克利分校的 Sproul 广场。

title.en: π-0.5 is here, and it can generalize to new homes! Some fun experiments with my colleagues at @physical_int, introducing π-0.5 (“pi oh five”). Our new VLA can p
title.zh: π-0.5 is here, and it can generalize to new homes! Some fun experiments with my colleagues at @physical_int, introducing π-0.5 (“pi oh five”). Our new VLA can p

note.en: Announces π0.5, the Physical Intelligence VLA that generalizes to homes it has never seen.
note.zh: 发布 π-0.5：Physical Intelligence 的视觉-语言-动作模型，可泛化到从未见过的家庭环境。

title.en: We made π0 “think harder”: our new Hierarchical Interactive Robot (Hi Robot) method “thinks” through complex tasks and prompts, directing π0 to break up complex
title.zh: We made π0 “think harder”: our new Hierarchical Interactive Robot (Hi Robot) method “thinks” through complex tasks and prompts, directing π0 to break up complex

note.en: Introduces Hi Robot, a hierarchical method that has π0 reason through complex prompts and break them into basic steps.
note.zh: 介绍 Hi Robot：一种分层方法，让 π0 对复杂指令进行推理并拆解为基本步骤。

title.en: π0: A Foundation Model for Robotics with Sergey Levine
title.zh: π0: A Foundation Model for Robotics with Sergey Levine

posts.source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…

note.en: TWIML episode walking through π0, Physical Intelligence's general-purpose robotic foundation model.
note.zh: TWIML 节目中详细讲解 Physical Intelligence 的通用机器人基础模型 π0。

title.en: Scaling laws in deep RL? Turns out that batch size, learning rate, and UTD (update-to-data) for getting the most efficient and scalable deep RL has predictable
title.zh: Scaling laws in deep RL? Turns out that batch size, learning rate, and UTD (update-to-data) for getting the most efficient and scalable deep RL has predictable

note.en: Shares an analysis finding predictable relationships between batch size, learning rate and update-to-data ratio in deep reinforcement learning.
note.zh: 分享一项分析：深度强化学习中批量大小、学习率与更新数据比之间存在可预测的规律。

title.en: We came up with a really simple way to train flow matching (diffusion) policies with offline RL! Flow Q-learning from @seohong_park uses a distillation (reflow-
title.zh: We came up with a really simple way to train flow matching (diffusion) policies with offline RL! Flow Q-learning from @seohong_park uses a distillation (reflow-

note.en: Shares Flow Q-learning, a simple distillation scheme for training flow-matching policies with offline reinforcement learning.
note.zh: 分享 Flow Q-learning：用类似 reflow 的蒸馏方案，以离线强化学习训练流匹配策略。

title.en: Very happy to announce that we are open-sourcing the π₀ model, weights, and some fine-tuned checkpoints! Hoping this leads to lots of great follow-up research:
title.zh: Very happy to announce that we are open-sourcing the π₀ model, weights, and some fine-tuned checkpoints! Hoping this leads to lots of great follow-up research:

note.en: Announces the open-sourcing of the π0 model, its weights and several fine-tuned checkpoints.
note.zh: 宣布开源 π0 模型及其权重和若干微调检查点。

title.en: Tokenizers matter for LLMs & VLMs. Turns out they also matter for VLAs! We figured out a compressed representation of actions (inspired by jpeg compression)
title.zh: Tokenizers matter for LLMs & VLMs. Turns out they also matter for VLAs! We figured out a compressed representation of actions (inspired by jpeg compression)

note.en: Shares a JPEG-inspired compressed action tokenization that speeds up VLA training fivefold.
note.zh: 分享一种受 JPEG 启发的压缩动作表示方法，使 VLA 训练速度提升五倍。

title.en: New paper by Joey Hong shows how we can train LLMs with value-based RL for multi-turn tasks *just by turning probabilities into Q-values*! This provides an algo
title.zh: New paper by Joey Hong shows how we can train LLMs with value-based RL for multi-turn tasks *just by turning probabilities into Q-values*! This provides an algo

note.en: Highlights work turning token probabilities into Q-values so LLMs can be trained with value-based RL on multi-turn tasks.
note.zh: 介绍将词元概率转化为 Q 值的工作，使大模型可用基于价值的强化学习训练多轮任务。

title.en: An intriguing new result from @katie_kang_: after training long enough, LLMs will reproduce training examples exactly (not surprising). But how they get there m
